title: xDrip unable to import blood tests values with "MEALTYPE:5" ="Bedtime"
symptom: When a blood glucose meter (Accu-Chek Aviva Connect or Accu-Chek Guide) sends a reading with meal type 'Bedtime', xDrip fails to import it and logs 'BluetoothGlucoseMeter: Received context packet but we're not sure what its for: Context: Sequence: 2467 MEALTYPE: 5'. All other meal types import fine.
fix: Workaround: The user stopped using the 'Bedtime' meal type flag on the meter.
evidence_quote: Workaround: I'm not using that flag anymore.
